title: Fix synchronization error event record context
summary: The LogSynchError method in Integration Synch. Job Errors table now passes the newly inserted error record to the OnAfterLogSynchError event instead of the ambient record, allowing subscribers to receive the correct error data. Two regression tests were added to verify the fix.
key_points: LogSynchError passes the populated, inserted IntegrationSynchJobErrors record to OnAfterLogSynchError event
Subscribers now receive the newly logged error instead of empty or unrelated caller record
Two regression tests added covering empty and existing caller record contexts
Tests verify event invocation, entry numbers, job/source/destination IDs, messages, timestamp, and exception details
No new infrastructure or country-layer overrides required
